Definition: Ephah, the name of a son of Midian, and of the region settled by him; also of an Israelite and of an Israelitess
BiblicalUsage: Ephah is the name of a son of Midian, and of the region settled by him; also of an Israelite and of an Israelitess. In Genesis 25:4, the text says "Ephah." The life behind the name is told on the Ephah People profile.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Ephah matters because God knows His people by name, and Ephah is one of them. That is why I want the name, and the person behind it, kept straight.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
